targets.title: Seventeen-month-olds appeal to false beliefs to interpret others' referential communication.
targets.evidence_quote: Therefore, we conducted a systematic replication study, across two laboratories, of an influential interactive FB task (the so-called ‘Sefo’ tasks by Southgate et al . 2010 Dev. Sci. 13 , 907–912. ( doi:10.1111/j.1467-7687.2009.00946.x )).
targets.outcome_quote: Results revealed the following: the original results could not be replicated, and there was no evidence for FB understanding measured by the Sefo task in any age group except for adults.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Authors explicitly conclude that original results could not be replicated. Adult task validation does not confirm the original infant finding.
